text: Which prestige real estate agencies in Australia are the market leaders for luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses, and architectural project marketing?

result.keyword: Which prestige real estate agencies in Australia are the market leaders for luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses, and architectural project marketing?

items.markdown:
The primary market leaders for luxury off-the-plan developments, high-end penthouses, and architectural project marketing in Australia are major international property groups like [Colliers](https://www.colliers.com.au/en-au/services/residential-and-living-transactions/project-marketing-and-sales), [CBRE Residential Projects](https://www.cbre.com.au/) , and [Knight Frank](https://www.knightfrank.com.au/) , alongside elite high-end domestic networks such as Highland, McGrath Prestige, and specialized local boutique firms like Place Estate Agents in Queensland.

### National Commercial & Project Marketing Giants

- [Colliers](https://www.colliers.com.au/en-au/services/residential-and-living-transactions/project-marketing-and-sales) : Dominates large-scale luxury apartment towers and penthouse collections through dedicated residential project marketing and capital advisory teams across Sydney, Melbourne, and Brisbane.
- [CBRE Residential Projects](https://www.cbre.com.au/) : Handles premier high-rise residential campaigns, leveraging global buyer databases and institutional developer relationships for landmark architectural buildings.
- [Knight Frank](https://www.knightfrank.com.au/) : Renowned globally and locally for high-net-worth private client advisory, ultra-prime penthouses, and exclusive off-the-plan trophy asset marketing.

### Elite Regional & Lifestyle Specialists

- **Position Property & Place Project Marketing (QLD):** Major players dominating the booming southeast Queensland luxury coastal and inner-city architectural apartment sector.
- **Highland Project Marketing (NSW):** Leads high-end coastal and metropolitan residential project sales and masterplanned luxury developments across Sydney and regional New South Wales.
- **RT Edgar / Marshall White (VIC):** Premium Melbourne agencies deeply entrenched in marketing high-design, low-rise luxury multi-residential boutiques and penthouses in affluent inner-eastern suburbs.
